notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 Testers needed
notes.content:
[p]Hey All, [/p][p][/p][p]I know its been a very long time since I have updated this game, however with its recent second life it has gotten, I figured I would go back in and start working on a new patch to address some issues with the game. [/p][p][/p][p]The current issues I am addressing are rogue kidnapper bugs, which sometimes makes the game unbeatable. I believe I have corrected this bug, but need your help testing it out! [/p][p][/p][p]if you are interested in becoming a tester, simply right click on Scrutinized in your steam library and go to properties. Then click on the Betas tab - Under Private Betas it will ask you for a code, enter this code here 

IReallyLoveTanner

Then click check code, that will give you access to the testing branch. [/p][p][/p][p]This update includes correcting the rogue kidnapper bugs, adding wasd key support for the arrow keys in the camera, and having the Skip on the intro always show. 

This patch will now always show the Made in Unity  splash, as I no longer have the professional version, since I do not use this engine anymore. [/p][p][/p][p]Please test - and leave a comment below. This is just the first wave of patches to come, I will address other stuff after this, and make some changes to the game as well. [/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a couple bugs in the database. 
- Added a safety net on checking the lights early in the night before going to bed early. Example: You check the lights, and they are all on, but the RNG gods punish you by randomly turning a light off as you file the last report. 
- Kidnapper kills you on spawn bug: I added another safety net. Hopefully it will be fixed now. 
- Fixed door glitch for breaker room knocking players out of map. 
- Fixed a bug in Nightmare mode which prevented some players from going past night 10.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - Detective Mode
notes.content:
We took in some feedback and proud to announce 'Detective Mode' 

What is 'Detective Mode' you ask?

In this mode you simply solve cases, that's it. 

No threats are active, don't have to worry about the lights or windows. 
No jump scares, nothing outside the crime solving mechanic. 

It's purely a crime solving simulator. 

Hope you guys enjoy this mode, and it brings in new players who would prefer to just do this.

notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
Sorry for all the updates, but want to get as much as everything ironed out in the early days. 

In 1.0.5 reports are now much more randomized, instead of pulling from a cretin pool each day, a random report is pulled from all 200 reports in the game each time.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1 Now Out
notes.content:
Glad to see everyone enjoying the game!

Today took care of some quick hot-fixes, this will be the first hot-fix update. Still working on a few other smaller bugs as well, but wanted to get this out to you guys today!! 

- Fixed a bug where players were able to bypass RootKit app by pressing crack. 
- Fixed a bug where you would by pass the rejected report que with out getting a game over. 
- Maybe fixed a bug where Tanner would pop infront of Camera and cause game to freeze.(Pending more testing) 
- Made adjustments on the Sec Cams lighting system. 
- You can now skip the intro with the ESC key. 
- Adjusted database saving.
